notes.title: Chipmonk! v2.0 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34431391/eafbbb2bf0483be926032176ae8a1c5ea0d41f43.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce that v2.0 of Chipmonk! is finally available! Prepare yourself for another adventure ripe with new obstacles. Yes, there will be cliffs.

Here's an overview of the changes and improvements:
[list]
[*] New adventure: Revengeance! 
[list][*] Features 8 new stages
[*] Unlocks by simply ranking on any leaderboard
[/list][*] Lots of various graphical improvements, including some new character animations
[*] Controller rumble support on Windows for XInput compatible controllers
[*] Additional settings options:
[list][*] Music and SFX volume options
[*] Vibration magnitude (on Windows)
[*] Camera shake magnitude
[*] Toggle double-tap for sprint/dodge
[/list][*] Settings menu is now accessible during a play session
[*] Help menu is now accessible during a play session
[*] Sped up back attacks, and made them easier to perform (hold attack, then press jump)
[*] Added a defense when thrown, pressing jump before landing prevents damage and increases recovery time slightly
[*] Changed cliff ledge detection to be a bit more forgiving
[*] Added a few more achievements
[*] Added additional keys for certain moves:
[list][*] 'Alt/Option' for roll/heft
[*] '/' for Special
[/list] [*] AI tweaks
[*] Collider tweaks in various stages
[*] Added music track for score screen when clearing game
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34431391/b90fb97553d486e0787e6f566ffda713bf8bd6b6.png[/img]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Chipmonk! Coming To Steam Q4 2019
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/QrdyrRZEyRo
[b][i]Chipmonk![/i][/b] is coming to Steam Q4 2019! 

Along with the Steam release, the itch.io release will be updated to v1.1.

v1.1 will include numerous new goodies such as:
[list]
[*] Records
[*] Achievements
[*] Improved controller support
[*] Initials entry for highscores
[*] Boss health bars
[*] Bugfixes 
[/list]
Now, it's back to bugtesting, the proper way...
